component.name: Photobrowser
component.summary: Fast photo culling for RAW and JPEG folders

description.p: Photobrowser is a fast way to go through a folder of photos, decide which ones to keep, and sort them. It shows RAW and JPEG files side by side, keeps RAW+JPEG pairs together, and stores ratings in darktable-compatible XMP sidecars.

ul.li: Browse a folder as a thumbnail grid and open photos full screen
Rate with 1–5 and reject with X, straight from the keyboard
Filter by rating, rejects and file type
Move or copy photos together with their sidecars, safely
Organize photos into dated folders by shot date
Ratings live in XMP sidecars, so darktable sees them too
